commit_message: feat: complete Phase 14.7 resilient routing architecture
description: RealEmbeddingModel introduced using SentenceTransformer('pritamdeka/S-PubMedBert-MS-MARCO'). Used across all fusion evaluation and screening experiment scripts. HOWEVER, in the SAME commit, scripts/run_retrieval_baseline.py and scripts/run_baseline_v2_1.py were created using SimpleEmbeddingModel instead of RealEmbeddingModel.
Experiment manifests explicitly record embedding_model as pritamdeka/S-PubMedBert-MS-MARCO. These are the only experiment manifests that name a specific embedding model.

commit_message: docs: setup Phase 14.5 guardrail evaluation protocols and audits
description: CURRENT_ARCHITECTURE_SNAPSHOT.md created. Lists 'Dense (SimpleEmbeddingModel)' as the dense channel. This document is DESCRIPTIVE (captures current code state) not NORMATIVE (does not prescribe the intended baseline). It was generated alongside the guardrail evaluation protocols.

The project ARCHITECTURE.md specifies 'evidence_chunks' table with 768-dimensional embeddings (VECTOR(768)) and IVFFlat vector index. S-PubMedBert-MS-MARCO produces 768-dim vectors. SimpleEmbeddingModel produces 7-dim vectors. This is an implicit mismatch.
